title.zh: 将莱特省托洛萨市镇托洛萨中央社区学校的名称变更为Daniel Z. Romualdez纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tolosa Central Community School in the Municipality of Tolosa, Province of Leyte, to Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tolosa Central Community School in the Municipality of Tolosa, Province of Leyte, to Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Tolosa Central Community School tại Thị trấn Tolosa, Tỉnh Leyte thành Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Tolosa Central Community School ในเทศบาล Tolosa, จังหวัด Leyte เป็น Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Tolosa Central Community School di Kotamadya Tolosa, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Tolosa Central Community School di Perbandaran Tolosa, Wilayah Leyte menjadi Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5340_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Tolosa Central Community School in the municipality of Tolosa, Province of Leyte, is hereby changed to Daniel Z. Romualdez Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
